```{r fig.height = figures_height_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT ORIGINAL DATA MEAN ± 95 % CI --- #

for(trophy_selected in c("autotrophic", "heterotrophic")) {
  
  if(trophy_selected == "autotrophic" & response_variable_selected == "evenness_pielou"){
    next
  }
  
  ggarrange(plot.ecosystems.points.legend(ds_ecosystems %>% 
                                            filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed"),
                                          trophy_selected,
                                          response_variable_selected,
                                          legend_row_n_input = 4),
            plot.ecosystems.points(ds_ecosystems %>% 
                                     filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed"),
                                   trophy_selected,
                                   response_variable_selected,
                                   legend_row_n_input = 4)  +
            rremove("xlab") +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "none") +
            font("legend.text", size = size_legend) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) +
            ggtitle(fixed_label),
          plot.ecosystems.points(ds_ecosystems %>% 
                                   filter(disturbance_percentage == "decreasing_with_size"),
                                 trophy_selected,
                                 response_variable_selected,
                                 legend_row_n_input = 4)  +
            font("xlab", size = size_y_axis) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) +
            ggtitle(relative_label) +
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(ds_metaecosystems$day)) +
            theme(legend.position = "none"),
          heights = c(0.2, 0.6, 0.6),
          nrow = 3,
          align = "v") %>%
    print()
  }
```

```{r}

# --- PREPARE DATA FOR ANALYSIS --- #

filtered_data = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(time_point >= first_time_point_model,
         time_point <= last_time_point_model,!is.na(!!sym(response_variable_selected))) %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_ID = as.character(ecosystem_ID))
```

```{r}

# --- CREATE MODEL --- #

# In the ouput lmerModLmerTest which means that it's a Linear Mixed Model from the lmerTest package

model = lmer(get(response_variable_selected) ~
               size * conn * disturbance_percentage * trophic_type +
               (1 | ecosystem_ID) +
               (1 | day),
   data = filtered_data %>% 
     rename(size = ecosystem_size_ml) %>%
     mutate(conn = factor(x = ifelse(connection == "connected", 
                                     "con", 
                                     "unconnected"),
                          levels = c("unconnected", "con"))),
   REML = FALSE,
   control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"))
```

<details>
<summary>Model summary</summary>
```{r}

# --- SHOW MODEL SUMMARY --- #

print(summary(model), digits = 3)
```
</details>

<details open="open">
<summary>Model ANOVA</summary>
```{r}

# --- SHOW MODEL ANOVA --- #

anova(model)
```
</details>

<details open="open">
<summary>Model residuals</summary>
```{r fig.width = figures_height_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT MODEL RESIDUALS --- #

qqnorm(resid(model))
qqline(resid(model))

create.res.vs.fit.ecosystems(model,
                             filtered_data)
```
</details>
